scope: Python syntax parse, synthetic in-memory fixtures, and temporary synthetic .tex files only.

tests.test: Basic raw arguments and independently specified Unicode/byte locations
Nested targets recorded individually in lexical order; alternative bar preserved
Escaped braces, escaped percent, and structural braces after a doubled backslash
Commented targets/braces ignored structurally while exact comment text is retained
Escaped control sequence and longer control word excluded
Backslash parity before percent distinguishes an escaped percent from a comment
Nested math and macro groups retained without interpretation
Whitespace before arguments and a nonnumeric nested illegible argument remain raw
Missing braced arguments at an ordinary token and EOF preserve intervening records
Unclosed outer argument preserves partial raw text, earlier record, and completed nested target
Every nested unclosed target is retained and reported
Comment through EOF cannot close a target argument or introduce a nested target
Bare-CR comments end correctly while raw carriage returns remain intact
Byte-read UTF-8 fixture preserves CRLF, Unicode, comments, and exact byte spans
CLI emits earlier and partial records to JSON and exits visibly with status 2 on malformed input
An unreadable synthetic UTF-8 source preserves records from the earlier synthetic file
An unrelated existing JSON artifact is protected from overwrite
Markdown output is refused before any write
Per-scan inventory JSON filenames are protected
